Definition: to gush over, i.e. to swell; (figuratively) to desire earnestly; by implication to ask
BiblicalUsage: Ba'ah means to gush over, to swell — to desire earnestly, and so to ask. Isaiah says the watchman answers, if ye will enquire, enquire ye; he says the waters shall gush at the Lord's presence; and Obadiah says Esau's hidden things shall be searched out. The word is longing that overflows into asking.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that God invites the asking: if ye will enquire, enquire ye. The waters themselves boil before the God who answers.
